title: Senior Cloud Architect / Engineer
description:
**Om jobbet**
  

Vill du kombinera din tekniska expertis med rådgivning och hjälpa kunder att utveckla moderna, säkra och hållbara molnlösningar? Nu söker vi en erfaren Cloud Architect / Engineer som vill bli en del av vårt svenska team inom Digital Architecture & Engineering (DAE).


Som konsult hos Advisense hjälper du våra kunder att utveckla och förbättra sina moln- och plattformsmiljöer. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet och omsätter kundernas behov till effektiva och långsiktigt hållbara tekniska lösningar.


Beroende på uppdrag och din erfarenhet kan du arbeta med allt från arkitektur och teknisk rådgivning till implementation, modernisering och vidareutveckling av befintliga miljöer. Du samarbetar nära kundernas tekniska team och beslutsfattare och får möjlighet att påverka både tekniska vägval och genomförande.  

  

Du får också möjlighet att vara med och utveckla vårt svenska DAE-team, våra tjänster och arbetssätt. Tillsammans med kollegor inom teknik, säkerhet och risk hjälper du våra kunder hela vägen från rådgivning och design till implementation.

**Dina ansvarsområden:**

* Designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla molnlösningar och tekniska plattformar.
* Stötta kunder vid modernisering, migration och integration av IT-miljöer.
* Utveckla och förbättra lösningar med fokus på säkerhet, tillförlitlighet och förvaltningsbarhet.
* Automatisera tekniska arbetsflöden och bidra till effektivare leveranser.
* Ge teknisk rådgivning och hjälpa kunder att identifiera och prioritera förbättringsområden.

**Dina personliga kompetenser:**  

Med ett starkt sinne för affärsmöjligheter och en god förståelse för konsultrollen är du en engagerad problemlösare som trivs med att hantera komplexa tekniska utmaningar och presentera lösningar.


Du är trygg i din rådgivande roll, tar egna initiativ och har förmågan att anpassa ditt arbetssätt efter kundens behov. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att bygga relationer och samarbeta med såväl tekniska specialister som beslutsfattare.

**Din bakgrund och erfarenhet:**


Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet inom molnteknik, IT-infrastruktur, plattformsutveckling eller IT-arkitektur. Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av att omsätta tekniska beslut i praktiken.


Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med molnplattformar, infrastruktur eller teknisk arkitektur.
* God förståelse för hur olika delar av en IT-miljö samverkar.
* Erfarenhet av att designa, implementera eller vidareutveckla tekniska lösningar.
* Förmåga att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska miljöer och omsätta verksamhetsbehov till fungerande lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med både tekniska team och verksamhetsansvariga.


Din huvudsakliga kompetens kan ligga inom arkitektur eller engineering. Vi värdesätter att du kombinerar tekniskt djup med en bred förståelse och nyfikenhet på nya tekniker och lösningar.

**Det här ser vi som meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud.
* Kunskap inom Kubernetes, containerteknik och mikrotjänster.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD och automation.
* Kompetens inom identitets- och åtkomsthantering, nätverk, molnsäkerhet eller observability.
* Erfarenhet av hybridmiljöer, större IT-transformationer eller reglerade verksamheter.


Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga områden.

**Vad vi kan erbjuda dig**  

Hos Advisense får du arbeta med spännande kunder och projekt tillsammans med erfarna och engagerade kollegor. Vi tror på teamwork, kunskapsdelning och stort eget ansvar och erbjuder en flexibel arbetsmiljö byggd på förtroende.


Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas, bidra med din kompetens och vara med på vår fortsatta tillväxtresa – i Sverige och internationellt. Läs gärna mer om oss och hur det är att arbeta på Advisense på vår karriärsida.

***Företagsbeskrivning***
  

*Advisense har vuxit till att bli ett marknadsledande expertbolag inom styrning, risk och efterlevnad (GRC – Governance, Risk & Compliance). Genom förvärvet av Transcendent Group under 2022 är vi nu den största oberoende rådgivningsfirman i Norden inom detta område, där vi hjälper våra kunder med rådgivning, tjänster, teknologi och fondlösningar. Vi strävar efter att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen för GRC-experter och har mer än 450 medarbetare på våra kontor i Sverige, Finland, Danmark, Tyskland, Litauen och Norge.*
  

*Läs mer om oss* *här*

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: Professional Analyst
description:
**Company Description** **Vattenfall** is a European energy company with approximately 20.000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.


Within Vattenfall, **Business Area (BA) Markets** optimizes assets and effectively sources and trades commodities, thus ensuring best value for both Vattenfall and our customers. BA Markets is active across Europe with around 450 professionals working from Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK.


 In BA Markets the mission of the Business Unit (BU) Operations is to drive the digital transformation. BU Operations consists of diverse and highly skilled employees from more than 20 countries. We work internationally from our locations in Stockholm, Hamburg, and Amsterdam.

 **Job Description**  

Do you want to take on exciting challenges and contribute to a changing energy landscape? Join our Fundamental Analysis team and use your expertise to develop valuable market insights and support better-informed decisions. Together with talented colleagues in an international environment, you will have the opportunity to grow, collaborate and make a difference.

**The department, team, and job**


As part of the Analysis department, the Fundamental Analysis team develops models and analyses on power markets, deals and assets, following an Agile / Scrum process. We provide model-based forecasts of power prices and analysis of price drivers to support decision making in the traded market horizon and beyond. Our analysis is based on fundamental power forecasting models covering our core markets on the continent and in the Nordics. We believe that the decisions we help make enable fossil freedom that drives society forward.


The position is located in Stockholm as part of an international team of highly professional, skilled analysts, located in Hamburg and Stockholm.

**What you will do:**


Build better models: Collaborate with your team members to develop our short-, mid- and/or long-term fundamental power-price models and contribute to our hydrological models.

* Improve our forecast by adapting our models to evolving electricity markets, such as producing better and dynamic assumptions for inputs such as electricity demand, stack, solar and wind production, etc..
* Turn stakeholder needs into new model capabilities. Communicate your developments to the stakeholders and gather their reflections. Examples could be volatility estimation or applying data science methods to update demand profiles.
* Use generative AI and AI agents responsibly to streamline our analytical methods.
* Improve model architecture, cloud efficiency, code quality and data integration.

  

Create insight: Run simulations and translate results into clear answers for hydro bidding and optimisation, valuation, trading and ad-hoc questions for our stakeholders.

* Deliver market insights to support decision making for battery and wind project valuations and hydro production planning.
* Investigate scenarios to estimate their market price and asset portfolio impact and support Vattenfall’s position on power market regulatory topics.
* Provide fundamental analyses that enable profitable trading strategies.
* Update our market outlook and present it to upper management to keep them informed on energy market developments.

 **Qualifications** **We are looking for someone with:**

* A good understanding of Nordic energy markets and a curiosity to learn more about Nordic and Continental European markets.
* Strong Python skills and a collaborative approach to improving code, infrastructure and ways of working. Experience with Git, DevOps, Azure or containerization is an advantage.
* Knowledge of quantitative methods, power modelling, mathematical optimisation or data science. Experience with an energy-market simulation tool such as EMPS is welcome.
* An academic degree in engineering, mathematics, or a related field, would be preferred. Energy-systems modelling is a plus.
* Fluency in English is required, Swedish is advantageous.
* Willingness to travel a few times per year, for example to Hamburg for team events or for trainings.


You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If this role excites you and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

 **Additional Information** **We offer:**

* Meaningful analytical challenges in fast-changing energy markets.
* An active Analysis community that shares knowledge on topics from flow-based market coupling to practical uses of AI.
* A welcoming, respectful workplace with flat hierarchies, appreciation for own initiative, open discussion culture and zero-tolerance for harassment.
* An international team where we believe diverse perspectives improves our work.
* A flexible, supportive Agile culture with trust, autonomy and no micromanagement.
* Support for professional growth, including learning opportunities and internal rotations.
* Flexible working hours, including working remotely up to half of the time per week.


We are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company. We work actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, religion, gender identity & expression, sexual identity, disability, religion, and ethnic background.

**More information**  

  

Location: Stockholm with the option to work remotely up to half of the week  

Contract type: Permanent


For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our Recruiter Johan Macdonald, johan.macdonald@vattenfall.com  

  

Trade union representatives Trade union representatives: Lars Erik Näsman (Unionen) and Sven Gunnar Gremlin (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall switchboard: 0046 8 739 50 00.  

  

**We welcome your application** **no later than 9th** of november 2026. As we may conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

  

Since Vattenfall is part of the Swedish critical infrastructure many of our positions are security classed. If this position is security classed the final candidates can be subject to a security vetting process, according to the Swedish legislation.

**We look forward to receiving your application!**

title: Linux Platform Engineer - Stockholm / Uppsala
description:
Do you want to join a growing team responsible for the layer between hardware and applications? Kambi are in the middle of a DevOps transformation and are building a sustainable organisation for the future. For our Engineering Operations department, we are searching an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer with automation skills. We are looking for people who are passionate to learning modern technologies, thrives when collaborating with others, have an agile mindset and are solution oriented.
  
  

Who are we? Engineering Operations supports the infrastructure of the organisation and the success of our partners. We ensure a stable environment twenty-four seven,year-round and we like open source in all flavours. We are dedicated to agile operations, believe dev-ops and automation are great ways of achieving that, whilst using agile methodologies to support our efforts along the road.
  
  

We thrive in collaborative, ever-changing environment where we are using the collective resources of the team to meet objectives and find the best solution together. The role In this role, you’ll build and maintain on-prem infrastructure with a wide variety of technologies around the globe. You’ll do this by delivering reliable, scalable, and universally available systems. Technologies we are working with today include Ubuntu, Debian, infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, NTP), globally hosted servers, virtualization (KVM), storage (Ceph), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), automation (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - reusable workflows) and private cloud environments, alongside our on-prem infrastructure.
  
  

Who are you? We’re looking for a solution-oriented team player with a solid background in Linux. It is also beneficial if you have experience with infrastructure automation, basic understanding of networking (such as dynamic routing, data centre switching, site-to-site VPNs) and a “security first" approach. An agile mindset is crucial for us, and additionally experience working with Ubuntu, Debian and Puppet profiles would be a great fit within this team.
  
  

**You will like us if you:** Think code & automation is the right way to evolve infrastructure. Driven and motivated to find the best solution to the problem at hand. Find technically complex systems thrilling. Detail orientated.
  
  

Enjoy home labbing or tinkering with infrastructure in your own time. Enjoy working in a self-organizing, self-managing team. Thinks business value delivered is what defines great operations. Like to work within a large global environment.
  
  

**What We Offer:** At Kambi, you'll join a collaborative and international team where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to make an impact. Some of the benefits you'll enjoy include: Generous paid time off to support a healthy work-life balance Health and wellbeing benefits for you and your family Pension, retirement, and insurance programs that provide peace of mind Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing resources Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth Flexible benefits designed to support your lifestyle and personal needs Recognition programs and company-wide celebrations Modern tools and a collaborative environment that help you do your best work Opportunities to connect, learn, and grow with colleagues across our global teams Whether you're solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented colleagues, or taking the next step in your career, you'll have the support and flexibility to thrive at Kambi. Sound like your next challenge?
  
  

If you're excited by Linux, automation, and building reliable infrastructure for a global platform, we'd love to meet you. Apply now and become part of a team that's building the future of our platform. If you'd like to showcase your work, feel free to include links to relevant GitHub repositories, infrastructure automation projects, or a brief description of your home lab setup. We'd love to see what you've built.
  
  

**Diversity & Inclusion:** Kambi’s ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect Databases, AGS-EMEA-Europe North
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about helping customers build database and cloud solutions? Come join us !
  

  

At Amazon, we've been investing deeply in building the right solutions that allow you to derive the most value from your database infrastructure. AWS is looking for a specialist solutions architect for our Database team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers to design complex solutions. As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe North customers across all industry verticals to enable large-scale use cases and drive the adoption of advanced AWS services. You will interact with other Solution Architects in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AWS.  

  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and trustworthy support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a key member of the AWS Europe North Specialist Solutions Architecture team your work will include:  

* Working closely with our product and field teams and 3rd party model providers, you will help enable new capabilities for our customers to develop and deploy data workloads on AWS infrastructure
* Design best in class database infrastructure solutions for all stages of customer and product lifecycles.
* You will have the technical depth and business experience to deploy database and data strategies.
* Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment.
* You will also work closely with account teams, research scientists, and product teams to drive model implementations and new solutions.
* Thought Leadership - Evangelize and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.
* Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback.
* Develop and support an AWS internal community of related subject matter experts.

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Hybrid Work  

We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near Amazon offices.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of specific technology database domain area experience
* Deep knowledge and experience on at least one commercial relational database (Oracle, SQL Server, IBM2), or open source database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB).

* BA/BS degree or experience in lieu

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of non-relational databases such as mongodb, couchdb, redis
* Technical Communication Skills; able to bridge the gap between business outcomes and technical requirements

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: AI & Data Lead
description:
### **About us**


Patriksson Group is a next-generation creative agency group bringing together brand building, engagement and creator-powered marketing. Through Patriksson, Inc Media and Patriksson Talent, we work at the intersection of fashion, culture and technology, helping brands build influence and drive business.


We operate across the Nordics and out in Europe, working with ambitious brands in fashion, beauty, lifestyle and beyond.

### **The opportunity**


We're looking for an **AI & Data Lead** to help shape how AI and technology become part of the way we work at Patriksson Group.


AI is changing how creative businesses operate, from research and strategy to content, marketing and performance. We want to move beyond individual tools and experiments to build smarter, more connected ways of working across our businesses.


This is a hands-on opportunity for someone with strong technical foundations, a passion for AI and the ambition to build something meaningful. You'll develop practical AI solutions, connect data and systems, and work closely with our teams to turn new technology into everyday capabilities.


You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership early in your career, influence how we approach AI and help build capabilities that create value for both our teams and clients.


You don't need years of experience. What matters most is your technical curiosity, initiative and ability to turn ideas into working solutions.

### **What you'll do**

* **Build AI-powered solutions.** Develop AI agents, automations and workflows that make everyday work smarter, more efficient and more effective.
* **Connect systems and data.** Work with APIs, integrations and data sources to make information more accessible, structured and useful across our businesses.
* **Develop our AI capabilities.** Explore and evaluate models, tools and frameworks, helping us build a reliable and scalable AI environment.
* **Make AI part of everyday work.** Collaborate with teams to introduce new solutions, support training and onboarding, and drive adoption across the Group.
* **Improve and optimise.** Test, evaluate and continuously improve AI solutions, measuring their usefulness, reliability and business impact.
* **Support responsible AI.** Help implement standards for data security, privacy and governance, working alongside internal stakeholders and external specialists.
* **Explore what's next.** Stay curious about emerging technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen how we work and what we offer our clients.


You'll work across our businesses, with the support of Group management, internal teams and external technology specialists.

### **Who you are**


You might be a recent graduate in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or have gained equivalent skills through your own projects and experience. You may also have a few years of professional experience and be ready for a role with greater ownership and impact.


We're looking for someone who combines technical ability with curiosity, initiative and a genuine interest in how technology can transform a business.


Ideally, you bring:

* A solid foundation in programming, preferably Python, JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Practical experience experimenting with or building solutions using LLMs, AI agents, APIs or automation tools, through work, studies or personal projects.
* An understanding of data structures, databases and software development fundamentals.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ideas into practical applications.
* The confidence to take initiative, learn independently and drive projects forward.
* Good communication skills and an interest in working with people from different disciplines.
* Curiosity about creativity, marketing, culture and the opportunities emerging technologies create.


Experience with cloud platforms, RAG, AI frameworks, systems integration or data engineering is an advantage, but not essential.

**We're looking for someone who enjoys building things, takes ownership and wants to keep learning.**

### **What you'll find here**


This is an opportunity to help shape AI development across an entire creative agency group, with real responsibility and room to grow.


You'll work with people in strategy, creativity, communications, influencer marketing, performance and operations, gaining exposure to different business challenges and opportunities.


You'll have the freedom to experiment, develop ideas and see your work make a difference. You'll also have access to external technical expertise and partners to support more complex development.


The role is based at our Stockholm office, works across Patriksson Group and reports to the Group CEO.

### **Interested?**


We'd love to hear from you.


Tell us a little about yourself and, most importantly, **show us something you've built**. It could be an AI application, an agent, an automation, a university project or something else that demonstrates your technical curiosity and problem-solving ability.


We're particularly interested in how you approached the challenge, what you built yourself and how it could be used in practice.


We value potential, initiative and practical ability over years of experience.

**Apply through Teamtailor.**

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people in their everyday lives.


Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.


In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.


By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.


Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.


As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.


If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

##### **Senior AI Engineer**


At Odevo, we build production-grade AI systems that change how residential living is managed at scale. Our AI Engineering teams are deeply technical, highly collaborative, and driven by learning. We work agentic-first: AI coding agents are part of how we build, and we learn from each other as the tools evolve. We help each other grow and take pride in building and running systems that thousands of people rely on every day.


This is a backend-heavy engineering role within our AI platform team where you will design, build, deploy, and operate the shared AI services that teams and products across the Odevo group build on. You’ll work with peers who care as much about engineering craft as they do about real-world impact - a team that shares knowledge openly and enjoys solving meaningful problems together.

##### **What our AI Engineering teams are building**


We work on AI systems that make every day work smoother for residents, support teams, and property managers - always with real users, real workflows, and clear impact. Below are some of the projects we’re working on today. There’s plenty still to explore, and you’ll help shape what we take on next.

**Document intelligence**  

We turn unstructured PDFs, leases, inspection reports, and emails into insights that help us deliver faster and more accurate service.

**Agentic case management**  

We are taking our case automation from triage to resolution, with AI agents that understand incoming issues, find the right information, and help our support teams resolve cases faster.

**AI-powered customer onboarding**  

We’re making onboarding of new customers faster and smoother by automating how we collect, organize, and understand the documents and data that come with them.

**Internal AI tools**  

We develop tools used daily across the organization—for example, OdevoGPT, our internal AI application where employees can chat with AI, work on projects, use shared knowledge bases, and run code - all with secure access to different AI models. We also run the shared services that support AI use across teams and track usage and costs.

**AI-native developer workflows**  

You’ll use the latest coding tools to push the limits of what a development team can get done in a short time.

#### **Our Tech Stack**

* **Backend:** Python
* **AI:** LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and more), AI agents, RAG, embeddings, evals
* **Cloud:** Azure
* **DevOps & Tooling:** GitHub Actions, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Langfuse
* **Data:** Structured & unstructured data, PostgreSQL, Qdrant
* **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, htmx

#### **How we work**

* We like to take initiative, move things forward, and own what we build, from backlog to production. We validate early, ship often, and improve based on real-world feedback.
* We work across many products, so you’ll get a broad view rather than one narrow area.
* We collaborate closely with stakeholders across the group to deliver solutions that create real value.
* We support each other through open dialogue, pairing, and shared problem‑solving.
* We’re a Stockholm-based team that genuinely enjoys being in the office – not just to get work done, but to bounce ideas, brainstorm at the whiteboard, and help each other out. You’ll step into a friendly, social environment where collaboration is part of how we work every day, and where we take real pride in building high-quality things together.

#### **Who you are**


You are a skilled backend engineer with strong Python experience. Experience with other languages is also welcome. You have a genuine interest in AI and how it changes both the products we build and the way we work. You already build with coding agents and are comfortable letting them take on larger tasks, while you steer and review what they produce.


You take initiative and ownership, turning ideas from early exploration to production, and are comfortable working across different products and problems. You also help improve how the team works - proposing better approaches, trying them out, and helping put them into practice. You care about clear, maintainable code, reliable systems, and solid system design, with testing, quality, and security built in from the start.


You share what you learn, value good ideas over titles, and enjoy working closely with your team.


It’s a plus if you have experience with Azure, Kubernetes, or DevOps and platform work, or if you enjoy product thinking and shaping what to build next.

#### **Why Join Us?**

* Build AI that improves everyday living for thousands of residents
* Work agentic-first every day, and help shape how we do it as a team
* Be part of a warm, supportive team that enjoys learning and building things together
* Take real ownership and influence how AI is used across a global group

##### **What We Offer**

* A playground for innovation with the latest tech and tools.
* A culture that values creativity, ownership, and fun.
* Hybrid work setup in Stockholm with three days at the office—balance focus and collaboration.


Ready to Shape the Future of AI? Apply now and let’s build something extraordinary together!

**Excited?**  

*If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, feel free to contact* ***Linnéa Berglund*** *at**linnea.berglund@odevo.com*

title: Steering & Controlling Lead
description:
**Job Description** **WHO WE ARE**


The Product Domain plays a central role in enabling H&M's end-to-end product journey. We support the business with the right capabilities, processes, data and tools based on evolving business needs and technology.


Working closely with Business and Tech, we drive continuous improvement, support strategic transformation, and ensure that our investments contribute to both customer value and business performance.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


As **Controller & Steering Lead** in Product Domain, you will enable effective business steering, financial transparency and value-based decision-making across domain. Working closely with Domain Leaders and key stakeholders across Business, Tech and Finance, you will connect strategic priorities, investments, resources, costs and business outcomes to support informed decisions.


You will act as a strategic partner to Product Domain leadership, combining financial, operational and portfolio perspectives to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and ensure resources and investments are directed towards areas that create most value.


Key Responsibilities:

**Financial & Performance Management**

* Drive budgeting, forecasting and financial follow-up across domain, providing transparency on performance, key cost drivers and deviations.
* Establish transparency on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) across products, platforms, services, vendors and technology investments.
* Analyse Product and Technology economics, including engineering capacity, internal and external workforce, vendor spend, cloud/SaaS costs and other significant cost drivers.
* Develop scenario- and driver-based analyses to improve forecasting and support forward-looking decisions.
* Drive insights that enable effective resource allocation, capacity optimisation and cost optimisation.

**Strategic & Portfolio Steering**

* Enable active portfolio steering by connecting strategic priorities, investments, resources, dependencies and expected business outcomes.
* Support long-term financial and resource planning across Product Domain.
* Provide scenarios and decision alternatives to support strategic choices, prioritisation and trade-offs.
* Challenge investment assumptions and provide transparency on costs, expected value, alternatives and opportunity costs.
* Support active reallocation of funding and resources based on strategic priorities, performance and expected value.
* Identify financial and operational dependencies across products, areas, domains and Tech Centres that may impact decisions or outcomes.

**Value Realisation & Performance**

* Establish and follow up on KPIs connected to strategic priorities, value realisation and business outcomes.
* Track whether investments and initiatives deliver expected outcomes and benefits.
* Connect financial, operational and business performance to provide a holistic view of domain performance.
* Identify gaps between expected and realised value and support corrective actions or reprioritisation.
* Develop insights that enable continuous portfolio optimisation.

**Insight, Decision Support & Governance**

* Turn complex financial, operational and portfolio data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
* Identify risks, opportunities, trends and improvement areas across domain.
* Act as a strategic partner to Business and Tech leadership, constructively challenging assumptions, priorities, investment decisions and resource choices.
* Support leadership forums with analyses, scenarios, recommendations and performance follow-up.
* Ensure appropriate compliance with governance frameworks, reporting standards and financial processes.
* Continuously improve and simplify steering, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and performance-management practices.
* Drive greater use of data, business intelligence (BI), automation and relevant technology to improve transparency and decision support.

**WHO YOU ARE**

*We are looking for people with:*

* Strong experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Finance Business Partnering, business steering or a similar role, with the ability to move beyond reporting and provide forward-looking decision support.
* Strong financial acumen and experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost structures, financial analysis and performance management.
* Good understanding of Product and Technology economics and cost drivers, including engineering capacity, vendors, cloud/SaaS and internal/external resource models.
* Experience with portfolio planning and investment steering, including business cases, investment evaluation, resource allocation, prioritisation, KPIs and value realisation.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand complex situations, identify key drivers and develop scenarios and recommendations.
* Ability to connect investments and costs to expected business outcomes and follow through from investment decisions to realised value.

*and people who have*:

* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate across Business, Tech and Finance and constructively challenge and influence senior stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial and operational information and translate it into clear decisions and actions.
* A structured and proactive way of working, with the ability to create clarity, drive progress and identify where decisions or actions are needed.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in simplifying processes and using data, BI, automation and technology to improve steering and decision-making.
* Fluency in English.

**JOIN US**

If you feel like your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your application with your CV in English (no need for cover letter) at your earliest convenience, but no later than November 8th 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

description:
**About us**  

At **Techrytera AB**, recruitment starts with you. We are a staffing and recruitment company with deep expertise and a clear focus on IT and Engineering. With our industry knowledge and close dialogue with both candidates and clients, we create precise matches where the right skills meet the right needs.


We believe that a truly great match is not just about a job description – it’s about your experience, your potential, and what you genuinely want to develop in. That’s why we always focus on the individual. By understanding your background, motivations, and ambitions, we can connect you with assignments and roles at our clients where you have the right conditions to grow and make an impact.


Our goal is to build long-term and meaningful collaborations – for both you as a candidate and for our clients.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to own and develop our CI/CD infrastructure across embedded and cloud software. The main focus is our on-prem toolchain for embedded software development, based on Jenkins, Docker and Gerrit with integrated static analysis. The assignment also covers CI/CD for our web services, built in Azure DevOps and deployed to AWS, plus a smaller number of systems deployed to Azure. It is a broad, technically varied role. The consultant works independently, turns high-level direction into a plan, and sets their own priorities. **Tasks** Operate, maintain and develop the on-prem CI/CD environment (Jenkins, Docker, Gerrit). Develop and maintain Jenkins pipelines and automation in Groovy and Python. Integrate and tune static analysis (CodeChecker, cppcheck) in the build and review flow. Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for web services deployed to AWS and Azure. Improve the stability, performance, security and scalability of build and deployment infrastructure. Plan and prioritise improvement work from high-level goals, and coordinate with development teams. Document the infrastructure and processes and support developers in using the CI/CD tooling. **Required skills** >5 years of hands-on DevOps / CI/CD experience.


Expert-level Jenkins knowledge, including pipeline-as-code (declarative and scripted Groovy) and shared libraries.


Strong Docker experience, including containerised build environments.


Gerrit, or a comparable Git code-review workflow, including integration with CI.


Python for automation and tooling.


Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML).


Deployment to AWS and Azure.


Static analysis integration (CodeChecker, cppcheck or similar).


Linux system administration.


Proven ability to work independently, plan and prioritise your own work, and take ownership.


Fluent English, spoken and written.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Europe North CSC Tech team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you like helping customers make hard technical decisions and then seeing those decisions through to production? Until now, our customers in Europe North have been supported remotely. We are building a team in Stockholm so they can work with Solutions Architects who are in the room when it matters.  

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead for a portfolio of customers, working with Account Managers to help them succeed on AWS, with a focus on generative and agentic AI, data and analytics, and security, as well as migration and modernization. The role needs both technical depth and business acumen: you will shape architectures together with customer teams, and you will also understand the customer’s business well enough to tie each solution to measurable outcomes such as revenue, cost and time to market. You will also mentor the junior Solutions Architects and interns on the team and help them grow into confident customer-facing architects.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the technical engagement for your customers, from discovery to production launch, working alongside the customer and partner teams who design, build and run their solutions.
* Understand each customer’s business priorities and build the business case for the solutions you recommend, working with Account Managers on account plans and opportunities.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CTOs, business leaders and engineering teams. Review their architectures and work with them on improvements to AI strategy, security, reliability and cost.
* Lead technical workshops, and design and build demos and proofs of concept end to end that show customers their use cases working on AWS.
* Mentor junior Solutions Architects and interns through design reviews, joint customer engagements and regular feedback.
* Build deep expertise in at least one domain (e.g. GenAI, data and analytics, security) and turn your engagements into reusable assets for the wider team.

  

A day in the life  

You might start the day on site with a customer’s engineering team, reviewing the agentic AI architecture they have designed and agreeing improvements together, with an intern alongside you. In the afternoon you review a junior colleague’s design before they present it, then build a demo for next week’s workshop.  

  

About the team  

You will join a team of Solutions Architects based in Germany, Switzerland, Spain, Sweden and the United Arab Emirates. We share knowledge, specialize in different domains and support each other on complex engagements. In Stockholm, you will be the senior architect on site, working alongside our Solutions Architect interns, and you will help shape how the team grows there.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics)
* 3+ years of experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and presenting them to senior technical and business stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience mentoring junior engineers, architects or interns, or a strong interest in developing others
* Hands-on experience bringing generative AI or agentic AI solutions to production
* Experience with data and analytics platforms, or with migration and modernization projects
* Experience with cloud security, such as identity and access management, data protection, threat detection or compliance
* AWS Professional or Specialty certification
* Proficiency in Swedish and/or another Nordic language

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Linux Platform Engineer - Stockholm / Uppsala
description:
**Do you want to join a growing team responsible for the layer between hardware and applications?**


Kambi are in the middle of a DevOps transformation and are building a sustainable organisation for the future. For our Engineering Operations department, we are searching an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer with automation skills. We are looking for people who are passionate to learning modern technologies, thrives when collaborating with others, have an agile mindset and are solution oriented.

**Who are we?**


Engineering Operations supports the infrastructure of the organisation and the success of our partners. We ensure a stable environment twenty-four seven,year-round and we like open source in all flavours. We are dedicated to agile operations, believe dev-ops and automation are great ways of achieving that, whilst using agile methodologies to support our efforts along the road.


We thrive in collaborative, ever-changing environment where we are using the collective resources of the team to meet objectives and find the best solution together.

**The role**


In this role, you’ll build and maintain on-prem infrastructure with a wide variety of technologies around the globe. You’ll do this by delivering reliable, scalable, and universally available systems.


Technologies we are working with today include Ubuntu, Debian, infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, NTP), globally hosted servers,  

virtualization (KVM), storage (Ceph), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), automation (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - reusable workflows) and private cloud environments, alongside our on-prem infrastructure.

**Who are you?**


We’re looking for a solution-oriented team player with a solid background in Linux. It is also beneficial if you have experience with infrastructure automation, basic understanding of networking (such as dynamic routing, data centre switching, site-to-site VPNs) and a “security first" approach.


An agile mindset is crucial for us, and additionally experience working with Ubuntu, Debian and Puppet profiles would be a great fit within this team.

**You will like us if you:**

* Think code & automation is the right way to evolve infrastructure.
* Driven and motivated to find the best solution to the problem at hand.
* Find technically complex systems thrilling.
* Detail orientated.
* Enjoy home labbing or tinkering with infrastructure in your own time.
* Enjoy working in a self-organizing, self-managing team.
* Thinks business value delivered is what defines great operations.
* Like to work within a large global environment.

**What We Offer:**


At Kambi, you'll join a collaborative and international team where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to make an impact.

**Some of the benefits you'll enjoy include:**

* Generous paid time off to support a healthy work-life balance
* Health and wellbeing benefits for you and your family
* Pension, retirement, and insurance programs that provide peace of mind
* Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth
* Flexible benefits designed to support your lifestyle and personal needs
* Recognition programs and company-wide celebrations
* Modern tools and a collaborative environment that help you do your best work
* Opportunities to connect, learn, and grow with colleagues across our global teams


Whether you're solving complex challenges, collaborating with talented colleagues, or taking the next step in your career, you'll have the support and flexibility to thrive at Kambi.

**Sound like your next challenge?**


If you're excited by Linux, automation, and building reliable infrastructure for a global platform, we'd love to meet you.


Apply now and become part of a team that's building the future of our platform.


If you'd like to showcase your work, feel free to include links to relevant GitHub repositories, infrastructure automation projects, or a brief description of your home lab setup. We'd love to see what you've built.

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

**Kambi’s ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace**


If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.

**Creating an inclusive environment**


We believe Kambi’s greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today.
